title: 口 mouth (口字旁)
intro: 口 can sit anywhere: left (吃), top (哭), bottom (告), or inside a frame (问). On the left it is drawn smaller and higher. Characters with 口 are about eating, speaking, sounds, and the sentence particles 吗, 吧, 呢, which were invented to write sounds.

texts.title: 读一读 · 口 mouth (口字旁)

lines.zh: 星期六晚上，我和朋友们去唱歌。
lines.p: xīng qī liù wǎn shang wǒ hé péng you men qù chàng gē

lines.zh: 小李唱歌很好听，大家都叫她“歌星”。
lines.p: xiǎo li chàng gē hěn hǎo tīng dà jiā dōu jiào tā gē xīng

lines.zh: 唱完歌，我们都饿了，就去吃小吃。
lines.p: chàng wán gē wǒ men dōu è le jiù qù chī xiǎo chī
wǒ wèn xiǎo li nǐ xiǎng chī shén me

lines.zh: 她说：“我想喝一杯咖啡，吃一点儿小吃。”
lines.p: tā shuō wǒ xiǎng hē yī bēi kā fēi chī yī diǎnr xiǎo chī
nà tiān wǒ men dōu hěn gāo xìng
